notes: Includes the new European Roulette in the poker-style Card Lounge, offline profiles and shared live spins. Adds six original character-specific text lines for each of 104 characters, including the four main characters and Dealer, mapped to welcome/thinking/betting/folding/winning/losing. Silent characters use gestures. Main-character recordings remain unchanged and play only at their designated outcomes. Action-message wording stays clear; extra catchphrases are rate-limited, and roulette shows one bubble at a time. Lightweight artwork, local music and existing room continuity are preserved.
